text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hosni Mubarak opens the Middle East and North Africa Conference, saying that the principle goal in Egypt is to achieve balanced growth.

- The president holds talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher on the Middle East peace process. Christopher stresses Egypt's important role in achieving comprehensive peace.
- More than 50 American companies have factories in Egypt and their numbers will increase.
- Mubarak calls for building peace together and stresses during his opening speech to the conference that Egypt wants to increase investment and growth rates and open up the economy.
- 188 Egyptian investment projects presented to the MENA conference.
- Egyptian economic policies are to increase investment and speed up privatisation, open up the economy and promote the production growth rate.
- Mubarak, Christopher and Arafat discuss the problem of Hebron. Christopher say achieving peace in the region requires an air of trust.
